question: Where can I get a list of mobile network antenna sites in Spain, with location, operator and technology?

answer.summary: No official downloadable list exists: the Ministry's InfoAntenas viewer (VCTEL) shows each station's position, operator and assigned bands (MHz) for mobile stations in harmonised bands, and its database (the Registro Nacional de Frecuencias) is restricted by law. The viewer's GeoJSON layer can be queried per bounding box; a community GPX copy (58,506 waypoints, May 2026) gives a national file. Technology is not labelled officially; OpenCelliD labels it but is crowdsourced and needs a free token.
main_caveats: The official viewer says station positions are 'orientativa' and lists only stations of current mobile operators in harmonised bands; it is not the full restricted RENAFE register.
No official national file: the layer is queried per bounding box. A whole-country pull was not done, so the official national station total is unknown.
One site appears once per operator with different IDs, and operator names are legal entities (TELEFONICA MOVILES ESPAÑA, S.A.U.; VODAFONE ESPAÑA, S.A.U. and S.A.; ORANGE ESPAGNE, S.A.U.).
Technology is not a field: only assigned bands (MHz) on a per-station detail page, one request per site. Mapping bands to 2G-5G is left to the reader.
The GPX copy and AntenasMoviles are third-party snapshots of ministry data (licence unstated); OpenCelliD counts logical cells, not physical towers.
answer.confidence_reason: Layer, detail pages and GPX copy were tested live and the access denial is documented by official texts; official national total, update date and GPX licence were not obtained.

attributes.note: Lon/lat per station in the viewer layer and in the GPX copy; the viewer calls positions 'orientativa'.

how_to_use.example_result: HTTP 200 application/x-json, 420,630 bytes, FeatureCollection with 692 features (671 distinct Gis_ID) inside the bbox. First: {"geometry":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-3.702911,40.433067]},"properties":{"Gis_ID":"2800027","Código":"DS MOBILE NETWORKS, S.L. - 2800027","Dirección":"CL Jordan, 11. MADRID, MADRID"}}. Detail page for that site lists bands 1845.10-1855.10 and 2110.00-2120.00 MHz.
steps: The viewer (vcne.do) loads this layer through an OpenLayers BBOX strategy; the request parameters are bbox (minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat in degrees) and zoom (the value did not change the result in three tests). The endpoint is not documented as an API.
Decode the response as ISO-8859-1 (it is not valid UTF-8) and read features[].properties; split 'Código' on the last ' - ' to get operator and site id.

For bands, request the detail page: curl -s "https://geoportal.minetur.gob.es/VCTEL/detalleEstacion.do?emplazamiento=2800027&codEmplazamiento=DS%20MOBILE%20NETWORKS,%20S.L.%20-%202800027" (tested) and read the table 'Operador / Referencia / Banda Asignada (MHz)'.
Cover large areas by tiling the bbox; one 4x4 km central Madrid box already returns about 420 kB. A request for the whole country was not run.
A text-only version of the same search exists at /VCTEL/visorAccesible.do?perfil=PERFIL_INFOANTENAS (opened; search by province, municipality, street).
reading_traps: The viewer states: 'la representación geográfica de las estaciones de telefonía móvil es orientativa'; do not use positions for distance measurement.
In the Madrid sample 21 sites appear twice (one feature per operator at the same address); 692 features are 671 distinct sites, so count by Gis_ID, not by feature.

Operators are legal entities and vary: TELEFONICA MOVILES ESPAÑA, S.A.U. (289), VODAFONE ESPAÑA, S.A.U. (212), ORANGE ESPAGNE, S.A.U. (137), VODAFONE ESPAÑA, S.A. (33), DS MOBILE NETWORKS, S.L. (21) in the sample; no Yoigo or Digi entities appeared there.

The same physical site has a different site id per operator (Marratxi, Calle de la Constitució 4: ORANGE BALR0214A, TELEFONICA 0700978, VODAFONE 20390); ids are not comparable across operators or with tower-company codes.
No technology field: only assigned bands in MHz and a licence reference. Reading 2G/3G/4G/5G from the band is not stated by the source.
A third party (AntenasMoviles wiki) claims small stations ER2/ER5/ER6 are usually missing from the official data; no official page confirming this was found.

problems: No documented API or terms of use; the endpoint is the viewer's own backend.
The Ministry told datos.gob.es the data is not accessible as a database and that the viewer exists only to inform citizens about exposure levels near their homes.
HEAD returns 405 on vcne.do; GET works.

recipe: Find the target municipality's plan: search its sede electrónica or transparency portal for 'plan de despliegue' / 'plan de implantación' (telefonía móvil).

Extract text: pdftotext -layout plan.pdf; in the Marratxí PDF the existing-sites table is under heading '5.1. EMPLAZAMIENTO EXISTENTES' (page 7) and the classification table ('Tipología') follows on the next lines.
Parse the rows 'CÓDIGO TOTEM | DIRECCIÓN | X | Y | HUSO | DATUM | COTA'. Trap: the second table (zone, type of installation) is split across a page break and its rows wrap; join on the site code.
Convert UTM to degrees using the printed datum and zone (ETRS89, zone 31N = EPSG:25831). Tested with pyproj: IB0035 (480235, 4385273) gives lon 2.76973, lat 39.61698, inside Marratxí.

Cross-check with the Ministry layer: a bbox of 2.766,39.614,2.773,39.620 returned three stations at 'CL DE LA CONSTITUCIO, 4. MARRATXÍ' (ORANGE BALR0214A, TELEFONICA 0700978, VODAFONE 20390) about 10 m from the converted point.
Site codes in the plan (IB0035) are the tower company's, not the Ministry's ids; match by address and distance.
if_unstructured.location_method: Plans print UTM coordinates (ETRS89, zone and datum stated) and street addresses; the Ministry layer gives lon/lat for the same addresses. Cadastral reference or orthophoto were not needed in the tested document.
